public_body: Board Of The Boston Redevelopment Authority D/B/A Boston Planning & Development Agency
overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged: notice was timely, no executive session occurred, public access was not denied, and the zoning-ordinance claim was outside the Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely post notice of its November 17, 2022 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the meeting was timely noticed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in executive session at its November 17, 2022 meeting to adopt the Mayor's executive order on affordable housing.
allegations.key_passage: The notice for that meeting shows no anticipated executive session and the complainant has not presented any evidence of one.

allegations.summary: Complaint implied the public was shut out of the November 17, 2022 meeting because it had no public participation.
allegations.key_passage: The public was not denied access to the November 17 meeting at any time, and we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law on those grounds.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board improperly amended timeframes set by the Boston Zoning Ordinance, a matter outside the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Such an allegation falls outside the Open Meeting Law.
